storage_policy: Read-only evaluation files must live outside the repository data tree, including resolved symlink targets. Do not convert them to training rows.
required_provenance_before_run: Exact candidate dataset repository, immutable revision, filename and file SHA-256; distinguish downloaded BM25 candidates from independently rerun retrieval.
Exact query and qrel sources, revision/date and SHA-256; retain all judged query IDs in the evaluation denominator.
Corpus and candidate reuse terms and attribution recorded with external input manifest.
Declared BM25 top-100, k1=0.9, b=0.4; an input manifest declaration alone does not independently verify retrieval.
Query/passage preprocessing and tokenizer version. The author's approximate cl100k_base limits were 32 query and 128 passage tokens; this loader does not truncate.
Immutable model/checkpoint identity where available, provider endpoint and requested/returned model aliases, typed request profile, library versions and code commit.
All raw requests/responses and failed attempts, algorithm request counts, whole-query wall time, successful HTTP latency and actual billing or clearly marked token-cost estimates.

candidate_format.requirements: Exactly 100 unique identified documents per query, ordered bm25_rank 1..100, with finite numeric BM25 scores. The one-document shape above is a schema example, not valid input or benchmark data.

qrels_format: Whitespace-separated query_id iteration document_id grade; grade is an integer from 0 to 3, or -1 for unjudged.

metric.name: nDCG@10
metric.gain: Raw qrel grade, not exponential gain; negative/unjudged grades contribute zero.
metric.discount: log2(rank + 1), with rank starting at one
metric.denominator: All qrel query IDs; an absent or failed run query contributes zero.

loader_verification_only: The loader verifies structure, hashes and isolation. Its success is not an executed retrieval experiment, model evaluation, or reproduction of the original tweet.
